facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports that in February 2026 Paratus activated a 2,000 km protected fibre route from Mombasa (Kenyan coast subsea systems) to Goma via Nairobi, Kampala and Kigali, giving operators in Uganda direct access to global capacity.

systems.system: Airtel Telesonic East and Central African backbone

note: Only the Paratus route names Uganda; the Airtel backbone is planned and names no country.
